purpose: Defines cross-polity scientific collaboration and joint directed research using real contributed laboratories, facilities, experts, data, evidence, materials, contexts, rights, communications, and result assimilation. A diplomatic agreement never creates free RP or merges technology trees.

collaboration_types.meaning: Two or more polities intentionally pursue one visible scientific/engineering objective and contribute real research capacity/assets.
Participants coordinate observatories/sensors/experiments and exchange selected observations/data without necessarily sharing all implementation research.
One or more participants provide access to specialist research facilities or test environments while scientific work/records remain separately governed.
Participants temporarily contribute expert cohorts/training/operating practice to selected objectives or assimilation efforts.
Participants jointly interpret a foreign device/record/biology package while each retains its own Understanding/Operability/Reproduction/Adaptation state.

scientific_objective.visibility_rule: A participant never gains hidden future-node visibility merely by signing a generic agreement. If a partner deliberately discloses a specific objective/record, that disclosure is a real technology/evidence transfer and enters the normal visibility/evidence rules.
scientific_objective.native_node_rule: A joint native-node project uses the shared possibility-node definition but each participant's own applicability, prerequisite knowledge, local access, security authorization, competence, facilities, and result rights remain authoritative.

participant_contribution_record.rule: Every contribution references real capacity/assets already owned or legitimately accessible by the participant. The collaboration record never mints an abstract research resource.

directed_program_capacity.rule: A participant contributing meaningful directed research to a joint_directed_project consumes one of that participant's available directed-program positions exactly as a domestic directed project would. A participant providing only passive facility/data/sample access need not consume a directed program position unless it is actively coordinating research work.

lab_and_facility_contribution.effective_labs: Only scientifically eligible, authorized, physically available Effective Research Labs actually assigned by a participant contribute RP.
lab_and_facility_contribution.diminishing_returns: Combined joint lab capacity uses the same canonical diminishing-return model as other directed projects; splitting one project across flags does not bypass diminishing returns.
lab_and_facility_contribution.facility_access: A foreign facility can satisfy a stage requirement only while the participant actually has authorized physical/remote access sufficient for that experiment.
lab_and_facility_contribution.materials: Required samples/feedstock/test articles must actually be supplied; treaty text does not create material access.

real_inputs: material bandwidth where datasets are large
language/translation or foreign-science interpretation where relevant
incompatible data/interface standards when materially real
coordination.rule: Coordination blocks or delays only specific dependencies actually constrained by these inputs. There is no universal cross-polity research penalty.

contribution_eligibility.scientific_work: A participant can contribute direct theory/experiment/engineering RP only to stages for which it has sufficient objective access, applicable knowledge/competence, authorized labs/facilities, and any required target-population/context applicability.
contribution_eligibility.data_or_samples: A participant can contribute legitimate observations, datasets, samples, materials, or facility access even when it does not possess all theory prerequisites, provided the contribution is physically/scientifically meaningful.
contribution_eligibility.expertise: Expert contribution depends on real expert-cohort/tacit assets and language/interface/security access; experts do not become copied permanent assets merely by participating.
contribution_eligibility.foreign_technology: Joint foreign-tech study can improve each participant's assessment differently because competence, compatibility, facilities, and acquired result rights differ.

pipeline: exclude unavailable, unauthorized, incompatible, or withdrawn contributions
aggregate real eligible lab capacity under the canonical diminishing-return curve
evaluate shared stage facility/evidence/material requirements from actual accessible contributions
calculate project readiness using actual participating competence/facility/evidence/tacit inputs without double-counting the same asset
advance one authoritative joint project work record
award participation competence/practice only to participants/contexts that actually contributed
on result transition create participant-specific result-delivery/assimilation records according to rights and real communications

participation_competence.rule: Actual scientific/engineering work can grow relevant field competence for contributing participants. Passive political membership, payment, or result receipt alone does not create experimental/engineering practice.
participation_competence.data_only_participation: May grow theoretical/experimental competence only if the participant actually analyzes/works with the data rather than merely transferring it.
participation_competence.facility_host: Hosting a facility without participating scientific staff does not automatically grant full competence.

result_access_policy.rule: Use the existing technology-exchange package/right semantics. A joint result can be distributed asymmetrically when the negotiated agreement says so, subject to real technical possession and policy enforcement.

native_result_assimilation.joint_developer_rule: A participant may advance its own native node through the normal maturation result only when that participant co-developed the result by actually performing sufficient authorized research work on the node and receives the necessary scientific/engineering result package. This is genuine co-development, not a free technology grant or passive treaty reward.
native_result_assimilation.passive_participant_rule: A participant that only funds, hosts, or receives a limited result package uses the normal evidence/tacit/foreign-transfer assimilation rules; it is not automatically Mature.
native_result_assimilation.applicability_rule: Population/species/installation-specific results remain scoped. A partner whose biology or infrastructure is incompatible may understand the result while remaining unable to operate/deploy it.
native_result_assimilation.physical_deployment_rule: No collaboration result automatically creates factories, fleets, populations, institutions, or production lines.

withdrawal_and_suspension.future_contribution: Withdrawn labs, experts, facilities, materials, samples, and data feeds stop contributing when real access ends.
withdrawal_and_suspension.already_delivered_records: Records already lawfully/physically delivered remain unless real deletion/recovery actions occur; political withdrawal is not a recall beam.
project_effects: pause/block if a hard facility/material/evidence/integration requirement disappeared
terminate and preserve completed scientific work/history
withdrawal_and_suspension.rights_consequences: Diplomatic/legal breach, payment, trust, reputation, and political consequences are owned elsewhere by Diplomacy/law; Adaptive Research owns only scientific access, contribution, result, and project-state consequences.

classification_and_compartments.rule: A joint program may be Restricted/Classified/Special-Access under the secrecy model. Each participant contributes only through authorized contexts/groups/compartments.
classification_and_compartments.cross_polity_compartment: A participant may receive only the compartments necessary for its contribution. This can limit later independent reproduction without preventing useful collaboration.
classification_and_compartments.compromise: Intelligence/Security owns leaks/theft; Research interprets compromised records normally.
classification_and_compartments.declassification: Changes dissemination rights/access, not truth or prior physical possession.

multi_biochemistry_and_species.rule: Shared biological research remains population/applicability scoped. A partner can contribute facilities, samples, comparative biology, or biochemistry expertise without assuming its own population can use the result.
multi_biochemistry_and_species.cross_biochemistry: Comparative collaboration can improve multispecies capability when legitimate alien-biology evidence and facilities exist, but incompatible partners do not automatically gain native operability.

cross_workstream_ownership.adaptive_research: scientific objective eligibility, contribution validation, joint progress, competence gain, result package/assimilation semantics, research-side pause/block state
cross_workstream_ownership.diplomacy_trade: agreement negotiation, participant invitation/removal, payments, rights/legal terms, treaty breach, trust/reputation/political consequences
cross_workstream_ownership.communications: actual cross-polity communication path, latency, bandwidth, secure channel availability
cross_workstream_ownership.intelligence_security: leaks, theft, infiltration, compromise detection, counterintelligence/protection
cross_workstream_ownership.construction_economy: physical facility/material/tooling availability and opportunity cost
cross_workstream_ownership.population: expert cohort location/movement and biological population context
